verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that a PlanetScale API and an API reference page exist (planetscale-docs-49), but nothing documents an interactive explorer or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The web console (docs-48) is a SQL query interface, not an API reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
